name: Aguatón (Spain)
description: A hoist third blue with a yellow cross bearing a yellow castle and a torch, the fly red with a triangular point at the hoist and two wavy stripes of blue edged yellow.
history: Municipal flag of Aguatón; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: cross on the blue hoist third
castle with a torch above on the cross
two wavy stripes edged yellow on the red fly
